title: Bell and Virgin say an unauthorized party accessed an internal system holding some customers' personal information
date_note: The CKAJ article (23 Nov) gives the intrusion date as 17 November.
summary: Radio station CKAJ reports that the telecommunications companies Virgin and Bell told subscribers that an unauthorized third party accessed an internal system holding personal information of some customers, on 17 November. The companies say the information could include name, postal address, phone numbers, email address and account information, and that no highly sensitive data such as credit card or bank account details was affected. The article gives no number of customers.
plain: Bell and Virgin told customers that someone without permission got into an internal system with some customers' personal details. The article says no card or bank details were affected.
exec: Bell and Virgin say customer contact and account details may have been exposed, with no number of customers given.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The article says subscribers can contact Bell and Virgin for more information.
impact: Some customers' contact and account details may have been accessed, per the companies.

evidence.quote: le 17 novembre dernier, soit il y a 6 jours

validation.note: Only the CKAJ local radio article was read; it relays the companies' notice to subscribers, which was not read directly.
